name: pawl
description: Deterministic gates for coding agents: stops destructive git, unbounded waits, repeated tool calls, no-op edits, transcript re-reads, cross-conversation snooping and leaky or bot-sounding sends; strips zero-width characters; approves provably read-only shell commands. Plain Python, no model calls, no prompt cost.

defaultPrompt: Which pawl gates are active, and what does each one stop?
